{{Quote|Captain McQuarrie, stand by to report!''"<br />"''We've confirmed the substance to be soil from the Moorja badlands, Admiral. It's an electrostatic compound with photoreactive properties.''"<br />"''In plain Basic, Captain?''"<br />"''The material clings to the shields like filings to a magnet.|Captain Pharl McQuarrie briefs Admiral Dron on the Separatist attack on Ukio|<ref name="Act on Instinct" />}}
'''Pharl McQuarrie''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Galactic Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later a [[General/Legends|general]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Ralltiiri|native]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], McQuarrie's Clone Wars service saw him [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] a [[Pharl McQuarrie's Consular-class cruiser|''Consular''-class cruiser]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] defense of the vital [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. Although the Republic [[Battle of Ukio|repelled]] the enemy [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Project Instinction|incursion]] from Ukio, [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Separatist interests]] ultimately captured financial control of the planet nonetheless.

McQuarrie went on to serve as a respected military [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[subjugation of Ralltiir]] just [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. After fleeing his home planet to seek assistance from the Rebel Alliance, McQuarrie returned to take command of the [[Ralltiir underground|Ralltiiri Rebel resistance movement]], helping to deliver information concerning the existence of a secret Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].

McQuarrie's efforts led directly to the subsequent Rebel [[Battle of Toprawa|capture]] of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] and the destruction of the battlestation shortly thereafter. General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] later handpicked McQuarrie to serve as his [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]] at the Rebellion's new [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where McQuarrie was instrumental in the facility's construction. He went on to serve in the Rebel defeat at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Clone Wars service===
====Captain of the Republic====
{{Quote|Is it doing any damage to the shields? Creating a weak point, perhaps?''"<br />"''No, General. It has absolutely no effect on the shield strength. But it is moving. As I said, photoreactive. It's staying aligned with the sun's path, regardless of the planet's rotation.''"<br />"''Diabolical.|Jedi General Keelyvine Reus and Captain Pharl McQuarrie|<ref name="Act on Instinct" />}}
[[File:PharlMcQuarrie-TCW.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Captain Pharl McQuarrie served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.]]
Pharl McQuarrie [[Ralltiiri|hailed]] from the prosperous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]],<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]],<ref name="CSWE-Ralltiir">{{CSWECite|III|76|Ralltiir}}</ref> and served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Act on Instinct" /> Early in the war,<ref name="Date">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'' places the [[battle of Ukio]] shortly after the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|death]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], as depicted in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Cargo of Doom]]." According to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, "Cargo of Doom" precedes the episode "[[Senate Spy]]," which {{FactFile2014|8|21 BBY 1-2|The Second Battle of Geonosis}} dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Given that 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] is the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', Ropal's [[Death/Legends|death]] must therefore take place in that year, thus providing an approximate date for the battle of [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]].</ref> McQuarrie [[Captain/Legends|captained]] a [[Pharl McQuarrie's Consular-class cruiser|''Consular''-class cruiser]] as part of a Republic mission to prevent the [[Politics/Legends|politically]] divided [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] of [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], a major [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]-producer for the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic's armies]], from falling to the Confederacy.<ref name="Act on Instinct" />

Joining a [[Task force/Legends|task force]] consisting of a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and another [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] under the overall [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Keelyvine Reus]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dron]], McQuarrie helped form an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] patrol of Ukio in response to [[Clone Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] suggesting that the Confederacy was targeting the planet. Although Ukio boasted a powerful [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] system capable of preventing any sizable invasion or [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] from enemy forces, the Separatists nevertheless concocted a [[Project Instinction|plan]] to breach its defenses. The Republic task force soon detected on the far side of the planet a single Confederate [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Ukio)|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] that was releasing into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] a series of [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]], which in turn were dropping a strange dark cloud over Ukio's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="Act on Instinct" />

====Dustup over Ukio====
{{Quote|Captain McQuarrie. What would happen to this material if the shields were deactivated?''"<br />"''Without a surface to cling to, it would simply dissipate into the atmosphere. The winds would scatter it.|Jedi General Keelyvine Reus and Captain Pharl McQuarrie|<ref name="Act on Instinct" />}}
At Dron's prompting, McQuarrie reported to Reus and the admiral that<ref name="Act on Instinct" /> his<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] had identified the cloud to be an electrostatic soil compound with photoreactive properties from the [[Badlands (Moorja)|badlands]] of the planet [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]]. The compound adhered harmlessly to the shield yet moved in concert with the [[Ukio system/Legends|system's]] [[Ukio system's star|sun]], regardless of Ukio's rotation, thus creating an effective means of blocking out any [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] from reaching the planet's crops. The Confederacy thereby succeeded in using Ukio's shield system against itself&mdash;as McQuarrie noted to Reus, the native [[Ukian/Legends|Ukians]] would need to lower their shields for the cloud to simply dissipate into the atmosphere and save their crop fields, but by doing so they would open the planetary surface to Confederate attack.<ref name="Act on Instinct" />

[[File:McQuarrieUkio-TCW.jpg|thumb|right|310px|McQuarrie fights to defend the vital agriworld Ukio from Confederate invasion.]]
Reus quickly conceived a plan to save Ukio. The Ukians would create an opening in their shield around the cloud just long enough for the disturbance to dissipate, while McQuarrie and the Republic task force would engage the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Lucrehulk battleship]] to keep it preoccupied and unable to launch any [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] through the shield gap. However, the Republic attack would need to be carefully coordinated so as to counteract any complications from the Lucrehulk's powerful [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] signal.<ref name="Act on Instinct" />

The ensuing [[Battle of Ukio|attack]] from McQuarrie and the Republic task force succeeded in destroying the Confederate [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], while the Ukians lowered their shields to rid themselves of the disruptive cloud. Although the Republic earned a tactical victory by eliminating the enemy presence from Ukio, negative market reports of the turbulence there caused Ukio's stock prices to plummet, allowing the Confederate-allied [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] to purchase a controlling interest in the planet.<ref name="Act on Instinct" />

===Against the Empire===
====Ralltiiri Rebel====
Following his active duty in the Clone Wars, McQuarrie served as a respected military [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Ralltiir,<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-R" /> but the escalating [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] once again forced the former [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officer]] into action.<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=General McQuarrie &ndash; Rebel General|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569519/2013-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-Series-2-493-General-McQuarrie}}</ref> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Ralltiir date">[[Empire 5|''Empire'' 5]] dates the [[subjugation of Ralltiir]] to three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Given that the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] takes place on [[Great ReSynchronization|35:3:7]], as explained [[Template:Yavindate|here]], the subjugation of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] can therefore be dated to 35:2, which would equate to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], as explained [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> McQuarrie watched as<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] enacted a brutal [[subjugation of Ralltiir]] to clamp down on the growing number of Ralltiiri [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers. The Imperial occupation force devastated Ralltiir and its 10 billion inhabitants, even barring relief organizations by sealing off the entire [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]].<ref name="CSWE-Ralltiir" /> In response, McQuarrie fled his home planet to seek aid from the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Who's Who" />

[[File:RalltiirDiversion-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|310px|McQuarrie's diversionary raid on Ralltiir helped secret information concerning the Empire's Death Star battlestation to reach Princess Leia Organa.]]
Coincidentally, the Alliance had just learned that a [[Ralltiir underground|Ralltiiri Rebel cell]] had come into possession of information concerning the existence of the Empire's new secret [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Working in tandem with his close friend<ref name="Who's Who" /> and fellow Ralltiiri<ref name="Hoth Limited-Jeroen Webb">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Jeroen Webb}}</ref> [[Jeroen Webb]], McQuarrie returned home, sneaked past the Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the planet, and took command of the local resistance. He staged a diversionary raid that allowed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] information to reach Rebel leader [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

The success of the Ralltiir mission led directly to the subsequent capturing of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] at the [[Battle of Toprawa]] as part of the Rebellion's [[Operation Skyhook]].<ref name="Who's Who" /> Thanks in part to McQuarrie's contributions,<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-R" /> the Rebel Alliance proceeded to utilize the Death Star schematics to formulate an assault that ultimately destroyed the battlestation at the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Following his action on Ralltiir, McQuarrie joined the Alliance as a general.<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" />

====Echo Base's second-in-command====
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] later personally selected McQuarrie to serve as his [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]] at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] secret headquarters on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Once more working closely with his friend Jeroen Webb,<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /> McQuarrie was instrumental in the establishment of the new Rebel base,<ref name="Special Edition Limited">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=General McQuarrie}}</ref> which was completed in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[File:PharlMcQuarrie-ESB.jpg|thumb|right|310px|General Pharl McQuarrie (background), second-in-command to General Carlist Rieekan at the Rebel Alliance's Echo Base]]
Echo Base had barely become operational when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tamizander Rey]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> the facility's senior [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]],<ref name="Hoth Limited-Tamizander Rey">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Tamizander Rey}}</ref> suggested to McQuarrie that no ship be allowed to leave Hoth until the base's [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|energy shield]] was activated,<ref name="Who's Who" /> a plan ultimately approved by Rieekan.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> McQuarrie went on to serve in the staggering Rebel defeat at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

Both the [[Alliance Database|Rebel Alliance]] and Galactic Empire maintained personnel dossiers on McQuarrie, documenting his military service from the Clone Wars through the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-R" /><ref name="Chrome Perspectives-E" /> In particular, the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Imperial Database|database]] reframed McQuarrie's actions at Ukio as "stirring up trouble" in opposition to the "orderly doctrine of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]," while noting that he had been routed at Hoth with his Rebel confederates.<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-E" /> McQuarrie was also listed as a known associate of General Rieekan on the latter's Imperial [[Imperial Most Wanted List|wanted]] poster.<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-Wanted">{{Topps|set=2014 Topps Star Wars Chrome Perspectives|cardname=Wanted Poster: General Rieekan|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/95721/cid/6713309/2014-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-Perspectives---Empire-Priority-Targets-9-General-Rieekan}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
General Pharl McQuarrie was a respected military advisor for many years on his homeworld of Ralltiir, having previously served as a captain in the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the Clone Wars. When the Empire subjugated Ralltiir shortly before the Battle of Yavin,<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-R" /> McQuarrie took command of the local resistance and orchestrated a diversionary raid to deliver data concerning the Death Star to Princess Leia Organa.<ref name="Who's Who" /> McQuarrie's ongoing military efforts resulted in the capture of the Death Star technical readouts and ultimately the battlestation's destruction.<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-R" />

[[File:PharlMcQuarrie-SWCP.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Pharl McQuarrie fought to free the galaxy from the rule of the Galactic Empire.]]
McQuarrie fought with the Rebel Alliance to save the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] from the Empire.<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /> He eventually earned assignment to the main Rebel base on Hoth as General Carlist Rieekan's second-in-command,<ref name="Who's Who" /> where he helped establish the facility<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /> in a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] environment that refused to cooperate.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Nevertheless, Imperial Intelligence derided McQuarrie as "a Rebel general of little distinction."<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-E" />

A [[Human/Legends|Human]] Ralltiiri,<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /> McQuarrie had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="Act on Instinct" /> which whitened with age;<ref name="Who's Who" /> brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]];<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /><ref name="Chrome Perspectives-E" /> and light skin. He stood 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and weighed seventy-nine [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-R" />

==Skills and abilities==
Pharl McQuarrie was highly intelligent and possessed strong [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] skills. He had an advanced fighting ability with above-average strength and moderate speed. McQuarrie was weak in [[Force power/Legends|Force ability]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Equipment==
As a Republic Naval captain serving in the Clone Wars, McQuarrie wore the standard [[Republic military uniforms/Legends|Republic officer's uniform]], sans [[Hat/Legends|cap]], during the battle of Ukio.<ref name="Act on Instinct" /> Later, during his [[Time/Legends|time]] on Hoth, McQuarrie wore the insulated [[Rebel uniform jacket]],<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /> which was reserved for Echo Base's command staff, including General Carlist Rieekan and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]].<ref name="ESB" /> Additionally, he donned other articles of the Rebels' standard-issue [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather armor]], including the [[Armor/Legends|set's]] [[Alliance Cold Weather Headgear|headgear]], [[Anti-glare goggles/Legends|anti-glare goggles]], [[Scarf/Legends|scarf]], [[Command gauntlet/Legends|command gauntlets]], [[Utility belt/Legends|belt]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|leggings]], and boots.<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" />

McQuarrie armed himself at Echo Base with a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]], which he wore [[Holster/Legends|holstered]] at his right hip. He also preferred a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] among his weapons of choice.<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Artist cameo===
{{Quote|They got the artists together to do a scene which was played out over a matte painting that I had done of Rebel ships parked in the ice cave. And we were going to be Rebel soldiers. I was a general (laughs) who walked by, you know, sort of crossed from screen right to screen left. You can see me if you know what to look for. Joe Johnston, and Harrison Ellenshaw, and Mike Pangrazio, the matte painters, stood in the foreground and had a few lines. They didn't trust me with lines (laughs). They knew I would flub up.|Ralph McQuarrie discusses his role in ''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back''|<ref name="McQuarrie interview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ralphmcquarrie.com/interview/mcquarrie/interview.html|text=The Art by Ralph McQuarrie - Interview|work=ralphmcquarrie.com; "Ralph McQuarrie Illustrator" DVD|archivedate=20031027114053}}</ref>}}
[[File:McQuarrie-Ellenshaw-Pangrazio.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ralph McQuarrie (center) poses with fellow ''Star Wars'' matte artists Harrison Ellenshaw (left) and Michael Pangrazio, all of whom filmed walk-on cameos for ''The Empire Strikes Back''.]]
Pharl McQuarrie first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> The character is portrayed by none other than ''[[Star Wars]]'' conceptual artist [[Ralph McQuarrie]], who makes a brief cameo<ref name="Insider 134">{{InsiderCite|134|Ralph McQuarrie: Dreamer & Visionary}}</ref> as an unnamed Echo Base general, barely visible as he moves from right to left across camera<ref name="McQuarrie interview" /> with his sketch clipboard in hand.<ref name="Insider 134" />

Accordingly, McQuarrie passes in front of a large self-created matte painting of several [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|Rebel transports]] in the base's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. In fact, all of the extras appearing in McQuarrie's scene are fellow ''Star Wars'' matte artists, including [[Joe Johnston]], [[Harrison Ellenshaw]], and [[Michael Pangrazio]].<ref name="McQuarrie interview" />

===Character development===
The Pharl McQuarrie character was originally developed through the [[November]] [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] from [[Decipher]] The set's [https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/SpecialEdition-Light/large/generalmcquarrie.gif "General McQuarrie" card] first provided the character with a name and brief backstory as a commander from Ralltiir.<ref name="Special Edition Limited" /> The [[2004]] [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]] article "[[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|Who's Who in Echo Base]]," written by [[Josh Radke]], further expanded the character's [[Canon|lore]] by coining the first name "Pharl"&mdash;an anagram of "Ralph"&mdash;and detailing his involvement in the Imperial subjugation of Ralltiir.<ref name="Who's Who" />

The [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct|''Act on Instinct'']], written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published serially on [[StarWars.com]] between [[2009]] and [[2010]], also briefly featured Pharl McQuarrie, establishing the character as a one-time Republic Naval captain during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Act on Instinct" />

===Inconsistencies===
[[File:PharlMcQuarrie-30thAnniversaryCollection.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Hasbro's General McQuarrie action figure]]
"Who's Who in Echo Base" from ''Star Wars Insider'' 74 mistakenly claims that General McQuarrie is not seen in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' and that Decipher featured the character in its ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game as a nod to the conceptual artist.<ref name="Who's Who" /> However, McQuarrie himself later confirmed his appearance in the film in an online interview.<ref name="McQuarrie interview" /> [[Lucasfilm]] did not officially confirm McQuarrie's film cameo until the [[2007]] [[Star Wars Insider 94|''Star Wars Insider'' 94]] article "[[The Empire Strikes Fact!]]"<ref name="Insider 94">{{InsiderCite|94|The Empire Strikes Fact!|The Empire Strikes ''Fact!''}}</ref>

Although Ralph McQuarrie had brown eyes in real life,<ref name="Remembering Ralph">''[[Remembering Ralph McQuarrie: Dreamer and Visionary]]''</ref> artist [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]] illustrated the character Pharl McQuarrie with blue eyes for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''Act on Instinct''.<ref name="Act on Instinct" /> The character is alternatively shown with brown eyes via Ralph McQuarrie's set photos from ''The Empire Strikes Back''<ref name="Chrome Perspectives-R" /><ref name="Chrome Perspectives-E" /><ref name="Galactic Files" /> as well as the General McQuarrie action figure from [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection]]'' line.<ref name="30th Anniversary Collection" /> This article therefore asserts that the character had brown eyes.
